parameters.description_en:
- Delete a single file by its UUID, for example: ef69b85f-****-4942-8a0f-211a82b48ec7  
- Delete files by folder structure by providing a prefix ending with "/", for example: images/. Wait patiently if the folder contains many files.  
- Support deleting multiple files and folders simultaneously by separating UUIDs and prefixes with commas (,). You can delete up to 50 items at once, for example: ef69b85f-****-4942-8a0f-211a82b48ec7,images/,docs/
parameters.description_zh:
- 按照文件ID删除单个文件，文件唯一标识，例如： ef69b85f-****-4942-8a0f-211a82b48ec7
- 按照目录结构删除文件，传入目录前缀并以 "/" 结尾，当目录文件过多时请耐心等待，例如：images/
- 支持同时删除多个文件和多个目录，文件ID以及目录前缀使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多同时删除50个项目，例如： ef69b85f-****-4942-8a0f-211a82b48ec7,images/,docs/
